purpose: 200-window SAC trial on the local population-and-corridor disruption scenario

training.checkpoint_selection: Final actor at 200 windows; development and evaluation follow a later user request.
training.checkpoint_cadence: Full checkpoint at episode boundaries and at exact milestone windows. In-episode milestones do not reset training. Resuming a saved checkpoint starts a fresh episode.
training.final_wave_horizon: all training episodes use max_episode_ticks; hold final configuration through any unused tail
training.replay_insertion_order: serial collection order on the main thread
training.episode_budget_note: About five transitions per 10,000-tick episode. Application and monitoring delays can change the episode count.
training.resume_to_400: Resume the saved 200-window checkpoint with an additional 200 transitions. Restore replay, optimizers, entropy, RNG and next simulator seed into a new output directory.

learner_details.algorithm: SAC; twin Q critics, target Q copies, automatic entropy temperature
learner_details.actor_training: Gaussian sample followed by tanh; squashed log-probability correction handled by SB3
learner_details.neural_feature_extractor: FlattenExtractor; no additional learned shared extractor
learner_details.critic_action_input: Clamp nonpositive normalized exploration to zero in replay, target and actor-loss critic calls; preserve continuous rerouting for gradients.

formulas: recent smart-car completions per tick / rate_scale
(current measured mean overhead - previous measured mean overhead) / max(previous measured mean overhead, 1e-6)
state.overhead_trend_missing_value: 0 when either measured mean is unavailable; cumulative-window mean remains null in logs.
state.overhead_trend_history: Previous completed settled measurement window from the same episode; reset at each new simulation.

actions.integer_rounding: Python nearest integer, ties to even; clamp to bounds
actions.preserved_controls: Controller sends only the two routing knobs. The scenario controls target population; other routing knobs are monitored for unexpected changes.

reward.no_before_mean: only negative throughput penalty; no measured improvement
reward.initial_acquisition: hold initial configuration until warmup + settlement, then one measurement window
reward.settlement_outcomes: excluded from reward, included in whole-run scores
reward.zero_change_action: same full settlement and window as a changed action
reward.timing_validation: 1050 ticks is provisional. Existing traces showed 5.15% departure carryover across five actual scenario routing changes. During-blockage carryover may be higher. Record per-window and per-episode audits without filtering trips or changing rewards.
reward.carryover_audit: A reward-window completion counts as carryover if departure_tick < confirmed_step. Report genuine routing changes and no-op windows separately. This is a proxy for delayed configuration effects.

runtime.performance_change: Original simulator and Kafka timing, one local learner and one serial Docker rollout.
runtime.traffic_reset: fresh unique Docker stack and Kafka state per episode; Python and SUMO seeded
runtime.resource_policy: one serial rollout, existing uncapped Docker resources; no global Docker settings changed
runtime.traffic_rng: original shared Python random module, as in the previously tested runtime
runtime.reproducibility_note: Original global traffic RNG and Kafka timing behavior retained as requested; matched seeds do not imply identical trajectories after policy changes.

deployment.action_rule: tanh(actor mean); no Gaussian sampling or network updates
deployment.checkpoint_format: JSON actor weights, feature order, frozen environment settings, model ID and update count
deployment.application_confirmation: Exploration, rerouting and the other six routing knobs match expected values within 1e-9. External target population changes are accepted.
deployment.startup: Initialize the external simulator with initial_configuration before either fixed or SAC evaluation.

scenario.schedule: Repeat the same event schedule on fresh simulator seeds. Actor observes monitored traffic features.
scenario.information_available_to_actor: Seven traffic and configuration features. Event schedule and road identities are absent from the actor inputs.

decisions.initialization: Fresh seven-input actor and corrected critics, learner seed 0.
decisions.settlement: Use 1050 ticks as the provisional shorter delay for this attempt.
decisions.entropy: Automatic tuning starts at 0.01, ten times lower than the preceding trial.
decisions.reward: Relative-overhead improvement and throughput penalty, with beta for absolute overhead equal to zero.
decisions.calibration: Use the existing frozen input scales and throughput floor to isolate the new training attempt.
decisions.evaluation: User will request evaluation after training. No comparisons or extension are queued.
